rationale: A $175,000 investment of USCo's excess USD cash into the approved low-risk tokenized money market fund (TMMF-USD-01) via the permitted rail and counterparty preserves projected post-investment liquidity at $825,000, well above the $650,000 minimum and after reserving for the imminent $250,000 supplier obligation. This amount is within the $250,000 policy and authority cap. As the proposed amount exceeds the autonomous threshold, treasury manager approval is required before execution.
